description: vmenon04's baseline: weekly updates, each release at least three days old, everything pinned exactly, nothing merged without a person. Repos opt into automatic merging with the automerge preset.

packageRules.description: GHCR gives no release dates, so the three-day wait can't be checked there. Without this its updates (my own images, Sure) would be held forever; with it they come at once, for a person to review.
One PR a week for GitHub Actions, majors aside.
A new minor of a language or database (Python 3.12 to 3.13, say) changes behaviour like a major.
A lock file refresh pulls in whatever is newest: the three-day wait doesn't cover it, so say so.
prBodyNotes: The three-day minimum release age is not enforced for lock file maintenance. Check that nothing in it was released in the last few days before merging.
